Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Al Amraky Bin Ali, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his brother<sup>asws</sup> Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man upon whom is the emancipation of a neck, and he intended to emancipate a person. Which of these two is better, if he emancipates an old man, or a beardless youth?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Emancipate the one who can be self-sufficient himself. The old weak sheikh is better than the beardless youth’.
